topics.title: New GDPx benchmark shows top AI models still fail 88% of real economic tasks
topics.why: SemiAnalysis just launched GDPx, a 206-task agentic benchmark grounded in real paid work, and even the leader (Claude Opus 5.5) clears only about 12% — a reality check for knowledge workers being told AI can already do their job.

topics.title: Google's new Gemini 4 Carbon model jumps to the top of the AI leaderboards
topics.why: Google's newest flagship, released October 28, just overtook OpenAI and Anthropic's latest on independent rankings, a reminder that 'best model' is a moving target knowledge workers should keep re-checking before locking into one tool.

topics.title: Anthropic confidentially files for a US IPO near a trillion-dollar valuation
topics.why: The ChatGPT rival behind Claude quietly started the paperwork to go public, a signal that the AI boom is about to get its biggest public-market test yet — worth watching for anyone whose stack depends on these vendors staying well-funded.
